Functional: Explain which model Antigravity uses

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A user follows the release note to select Neon in a newly initialized repo by adding `[models.build.antigravity]` with the stated model. The generated settings have no such table (`src/forge/init.py:77`), and validation also requires an `effort` entry (`src/forge/repo.py:893`), so Forge rejects the configuration before starting work. Repos with a flat `[models.build]` must also convert it to per-family tables before adding the Antigravity table (`src/forge/repo.py:877`). Even with a valid build entry, user-facing builds select the design entry instead (`src/forge/worker.py:192`, `src/forge/repo.py:809`) and can still use the account default. The previous finding's guidance for selecting Neon remains incomplete.
